verdict.rationale: Showing live connections on the host and letting the user disconnect or revoke a device is a fair question for a remote-access tool like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a host-side live connection list or a disconnect/revoke control. Audit logs, connection logs and asset discovery are adjacent features covering history or inventory, not live session control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
